description: $8,000 for a 12-month, faculty-mentored research project with NASA, commercial space, or ISS relevance, for STEM undergraduates at NC colleges.
eligibility_text: U.S. citizen; enrolled full-time (or accepted for full-time enrollment) in a STEM bachelor's program at an accredited North Carolina college or university; minimum 3.0 GPA; propose a research project relevant to NASA, commercial space, and/or the ISS. Up to two awards total, reapplying each time.
